name: MM-Lifelong
description:
MM-Lifelong
	


	
		
		Summary
	

We introduce MM-Lifelong, a dataset designed for Multimodal Lifelong Understanding. MM-Lifelong comprises 181.1 hours of footage across three domains.
The dataset contains 1289 questions with 1810 distinct clue intervals.
Crucially, the distribution of temporal certificates confirms the ``Lifelong'' nature of the benchmark: 267 questions require reasoning over a span of 1-10 hours, and 127 questions involve ultra-long dependencies exceeding 10 hours.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CG-Bench/MM-Lifelong.
reputation: A specialized, recently introduced benchmark for very long-range multimodal/video reasoning that is gaining attention in the video-language research community but remains relatively niche.
